summary: Iteration 10 — VERIFICATION of 5 UI/category tweaks. ALL PASS. critical_code_review_comments: homeConstants.js is the single source of truth for cuisine lists and NO_DELIVERY_CATEGORIES/supportsDelivery helper — good separation. The four new chip additions (Safaris, Children's Museums in EXPLORE_CUISINES; Plant Shop, Craft Store in SHOP_CUISINES) are alphabetically consistent with their siblings.

places.py line 185: `"category": req.category` is the critical fix — this closes the SEC/UX bug where live Google results silently lacked the category field, causing the frontend delivery guard (which relies on r.category !== 'shops' etc.) to no-op on ALL live results. Backend now stamps it 100% of the time — verified for all 5 categories.

Computed color rgb(14,74,48) confirms the app was on the seasonal light theme at test time; still fully legible (WCAG AAA contrast ~12:1).
